title: Fix local llama.cpp web_research grammar compatibility
description: Preserve 2000-character runtime validation while avoiding llama.cpp nested maxLength >= 2000 grammar failure; improve agent-facing descriptions without degrading hosted-provider behavior; add deterministic regression tests.

logs.msg: Confirmed llama.cpp #25746 nested maxLength >= 2000 failure on web_research. Investigating Pi provider request hook for provider-specific outgoing schema adaptation.

Pi 0.84 provides before_provider_request after provider serialization; ctx.model exposes api/provider/baseUrl. Implementing local-endpoint-only adaptation of web_research outgoing parameters, leaving public TypeBox and runtime maxLength 2000 unchanged. This avoids hosted-provider changes.

Implemented local/private OpenAI-compatible before_provider_request adaptation; preserved public/runtime 2000 bound; rewrote agent-facing descriptions and schemas; full bun run check passes (192 tests, 461 assertions).
